title: OrderHub customer app brand
description: One restaurant's store app. brands/load.js enforces the same rules at build time.

slug.description: File name and the last part of both store ids. Lowercase letters and digits only: Android package names can't contain hyphens.

name.description: App name under the icon (keep it under ~12 characters).

brandId.description: OrderHub Brand.id — push installs and offers are filed under it.

locationId.description: Optional Location.id, for a single-shop brand.

storefrontUrl.description: Full storefront URL including ?brand= when the shop trades several brands.

apiUrl.description: API base ending in /api. Defaults to production.

adaptiveIcon.description: Android foreground, 1024×1024 PNG with alpha. Default brands/<slug>/adaptive-icon.png

notificationIcon.description: Android status-bar icon, white on transparent. Default brands/<slug>/notification-icon.png

version.description: Store version string. Build numbers are managed remotely by EAS.

ascAppId.description: App Store Connect app id, once the app record exists.

easProjectId.description: EAS project for this brand (one per brand, so OTA updates and credentials never cross brands). Null until `npm run brand -- init <slug>`.
